# Precedence test for option resolution in CONGA:
# Asserts 12-Factor App precedence: CLI Flag > Environment Variable > Config File > Default

# 1. Default Values
exec test-app
stdout 'app running: port=8080 host=127.0.0.1 env=dev debug=false \(config= source=none\)'

# 2. Config File Overrides Default
exec test-app --config-file app.toml
stdout 'app running: port=9001 host=10.0.0.1 env=staging debug=true \(config=app.toml source=cli\)'

# 3. Environment Variable Overrides Config File
env CONGA_TEST_APP_PORT=9203
exec test-app --config-file app.toml
stdout 'app running: port=9203 host=10.0.0.1 env=staging debug=true \(config=app.toml source=cli\)'

# 4. CLI Flag Overrides Environment Variable and Config File
exec test-app --config-file app.toml --port 9003
stdout 'app running: port=9003 host=10.0.0.1 env=staging debug=true \(config=app.toml source=cli\)'

-- app.toml --
port = 9001
host = "10.0.0.1"
env = "staging"
debug = true
